scripts.build:ui: cd web/app && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:api: cd web/backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.lint: echo 'linting changed (backend)...' && (cd web/backend && npm run lint) && echo 'linting changed (app)...' && (cd web/app && npm run lint) && echo 'linting mobile...' && (cd mobile && npm run lint) && echo '✅ lint passed (changed files)'
scripts.lint:all: echo 'linting backend...' && (cd web/backend && npm run lint:all) && echo 'linting app...' && (cd web/app && npm run lint:all) && echo 'linting mobile...' && (cd mobile && npm run lint:all) && echo '✅ lint passed (all files)'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && echo '✅ all passed (changed lint)'
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:all && echo '✅ all passed (full lint)'
